name: rieszMeasure
statement: = (rieszContent (toNNRealLinear Λ)).measure  /-- If `f` assumes values between `0` and `1` and the support is contained in `V`, then `Λ f ≤ rieszMeasure V`. -/ lemma le_rieszMeasure_tsupport_subset {f : C_c(X, ℝ)} (hf : ∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) {V : Set X} (hV : tsupport f ⊆ V) : ENNReal.ofReal (Λ f) ≤ rieszMeasure Λ V

name: range_cut_partition
statement: C_c(X, ℝ)) (a : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) (hf : range f ⊆ Ioo a (a + N * ε)) : ∃ (E : Fin N → Set X), tsupport f = ⋃ j, E j ∧ univ.PairwiseDisjoint E ∧ (∀ n : Fin N, ∀ x ∈ E n, a + ε * n < f x ∧ f x ≤ a + ε * (n + 1)) ∧ ∀ n : Fin N, MeasurableSet (E n)

have_tree.name: partition_aux
have_tree.type: range f ⊆ ⋃ n, Ioc (y n - ε) (y n)

name: exists_open_approx
statement: C_c(X, ℝ)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (E : Set X) {μ : Content X} (hμ : μ.outerMeasure E ≠ ∞) (hμ' : MeasurableSet E) {c : ℝ} (hfE : ∀ x ∈ E, f x < c) : ∃ (V : Opens X), E ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, f x < c) ∧ μ.measure V ≤ μ.measure E + ENNReal.ofReal ε

name: integral_riesz_aux
statement: C_c(X, ℝ)) : Λ f ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂(rieszMeasure Λ)

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.type: ∀ n, (y n - ε') * μ.real (E n) ≤ ∫ x in (E n), f x ∂μ

name: measure_le_of_isCompact_of_integral
statement: ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂ν) ⦃K : Set X⦄ (hK : IsCompact K) : μ K ≤ ν K

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Measure.exists_innerRegular_eq_of_isCompact
statement: Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) (h : μ Kᶜ = 0) : ∃ (ν : Measure X), ν.InnerRegular ∧ IsFiniteMeasure ν ∧ ν Kᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ g : X →ᵇ ℝ, ∫ x, g x ∂μ = ∫ x, g x ∂ν
